summary: HarbourVest Private Equity Secondaries Fund (TE) L.P. filed an 8-K reporting a routine continuous private placement of unregistered limited partnership units under Item 3.02, plus Item 8.01 disclosure of Transactional NAV mechanics. On September 1, 2026, the Fund sold 3,975 Class I Units for approximately $40,000, finalized September 29, 2026, based on August 31, 2026 Transactional NAVs. The broader HSEC Fund Complex issued interests for roughly $79.3 million the same day. Sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D to accredited investors and qualified purchasers. No special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms apply; monitoring relates only to ongoing NAV-based subscriptions.
